title: FPGA-GEN: Target-Aware RTL Generation via HLS
abstract: arXiv:2611.25351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Successful C/C++ compilation does not guarantee correct or efficient FPGA hardware after high-level synthesis (HLS). FPGA-GEN is an agentic HLS-C generation workflow that encodes specification, readiness, selection, repair, and admission rules in explicit task contracts and bounded tool-feedback loops for candidate-level decisions. On HLS-Eval, five shared-context outputs per task yield 407/425 (95.8%) public-testbench passes. In a cumulative conversion campaign, FPGA-GEN admits 104/107 (97.2%) HLS-LeVeri designs under held-out co-simulation, Vivado synthesis/fit, and same-RTL evidence. In focused TensorCore screening, selected candidate 3 reports 73.7% fewer CSynth cycles and 14.6% fewer LUTs than generated/composed C0, with 26.7% more DSPs, and passes development CoSim.

translated_title: FPGA-GEN：通过高层次综合实现目标感知的RTL生成
translated_abstract: 成功的C/C++编译并不能保证经过高层次综合（HLS）后得到正确或高效的FPGA硬件。FPGA-GEN是一种代理式HLS-C生成工作流，它将规范、就绪性、选择、修复和准入规则编码在显式的任务契约和有界工具反馈循环中，用于候选层面的决策。在HLS-Eval基准上，每个任务生成五个共享上下文的输出，获得了407/425（95.8%）的公开测试平台通过率。在一项累积转换活动中，FPGA-GEN在保留集协同仿真、Vivado综合/布局布线以及相同RTL证据的验证下，接纳了104/107（97.2%）的HLS-LeVeri设计。在针对TensorCore的筛选中，选定的候选方案3比生成的/组合的C0基准减少了73.7%的CSynth周期和14.6%的LUT，同时DSP增加了26.7%，并通过了开发阶段的协同仿真验证。
tldr: FPGA-GEN是一种代理式HLS-C生成工作流，通过显式任务契约和有界工具反馈循环实现目标感知的RTL生成，在HLS-Eval上达到95.8%的测试通过率，并生成出比基线方案减少73.7%综合周期和14.6% LUT的高效FPGA硬件设计。
en_tdlr: FPGA-GEN is an agentic HLS-C generation workflow that achieves target-aware RTL generation via explicit task contracts and bounded tool-feedback loops, achieving 95.8% testbench pass rate on HLS-Eval and producing hardware designs with 73.7% fewer synthesis cycles and 14.6% fewer LUTs than baseline solutions.
